description: This PHP source file defines a web interface for configuring RIP routing protocol settings, including interface selection, version, update interval, authentication, and neighbors. It includes external PHP modules, embeds JavaScript for dynamic UI behavior, and handles form submissions to update network routing settings.

methods.name: initPopulate
methods.description: Initializes form fields with current RIP configuration data retrieved via JavaScript object jsRIPEntry.

methods.name: initEventHandler
methods.description: Sets enabled/disabled states for authentication fields based on selected authentication type.

methods.name: saveRIP
methods.description: Sends the configuration data to the server via AJAX to update the RIP settings.
